#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader() {}
    InputReader(FILE* stream) {
        this->stream = stream;
    }

    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1)
            throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            try {
                numChars = fread(buf, 1, 1024, stream);
            } catch (exception& e) {
                throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            }
            if (numChars <= 0)
                return -1;
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }

    int readInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c))
            c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            res *= 10;
            res += c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }

    double readDouble() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c))
            c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        double res = 0;
        while (!isSpaceChar(c) && c != '.') {
            if (c == 'e' || c == 'E')
                return res * pow(10, readInt());
            if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            res *= 10;
            res += c - '0';
            c = read();
        }
        if (c == '.') {
            c = read();
            double m = 1;
            while (!isSpaceChar(c)) {
                if (c == 'e' || c == 'E')
                    return res * pow(10, readInt());
                if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                    throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
                m /= 10;
                res += (c - '0') * m;
                c = read();
            }
        }
        return res * sgn;
    }

    long readLong() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c))
            c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        long res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            res *= 10;
            res += c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }

    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }

    string next() {
        return readString();
    }

private:
    FILE* stream;
    int curChar;
    int numChars;
    char buf[1024];
};

class OutputWriter {
public:
    OutputWriter() {}
    OutputWriter(FILE* stream) {
        this->stream = stream;
    }

    void print(const char* str) {
        fprintf(stream, "%s", str);
    }

    void print(int num) {
        fprintf(stream, "%d", num);
    }

    void print(double num) {
        fprintf(stream, "%lf", num);
    }

    void println() {
        print("\n");
    }

    void println(const char* str) {
        print(str);
        println();
    }

    void println(int num) {
        print(num);
        println();
    }

    void println(double num) {
        print(num);
        println();
    }

    void close() {
        fclose(stream);
    }

private:
    FILE* stream;
};

int main() {
    InputReader in;
    OutputWriter out;

    int n = in.readInt();
    string st = in.readString();
    char c[st.length()];
    strcpy(c, st.c_str());
    int a1 = 0, a2 = 0;
    string sb, sb2;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (c[i] == '(') {
            sb += "_";
            i++;
            while (i < n && c[i] != ')') {
                sb2 += c[i];
                i++;
            }
            sb2 += "_";
        } else if (i < n) {
            sb += c[i];
        }
    }
    string s[100];
    istringstream iss(sb);
    int count = 0;
    while (iss >> s[count]) {
        count++;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        a1 = max(a1, s[i].length());
    }
    iss.clear();
    iss.str(sb2);
    count = 0;
    while (iss >> s[count]) {
        count++;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        if (s[i].length() > 0) a2++;
    }
    out.print(a1);
    out.print(" ");
    out.print(a2);
    out.println();
    out.close();

    return 0;
}
